crossRefs.note: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and will he not do it? Or…
Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.
in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

translations.web: “Now, O Lord Yahweh, you are God, and your words are truth, and you have promised this good thing to your servant.
translations.bsb: And now, O Lord GOD, You are God! Your words are true, and You have promised this goodness to Your servant.
translations.kjv: And now, O Lord GOD, thou art that God, and thy words be true, and thou hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
translations.asv: And now, O Lord Jehovah, thou art God, and thy words are truth, and thou hast promised this good thing unto thy servant:
